semanticReview.method: Manual claim-by-claim comparison with primary Taiwan Ministry of Education punctuation references

findings.supports: The punctuation handbook specifies the full-width colon symbol, its one-character centered placement, announcement/explanation function, enumeration and quotation examples.
The dictionary names 冒號 and gives Hanyu Pinyin mào hào.
The handbook defines 頓號 as separating parallel words/phrases or marking list order, distinct from the colon.

limitations: Corrected the original claim that the symbol looks identical to the Spanish half-width colon; retained Taiwan’s full-width 「：」.
Replaced unsourced examples with cases and wording from the Ministry handbook.
